SELECT fiscal_period_label, MIN(calendar_date) AS d0, MAX(calendar_date) AS d1, COUNT(*) AS days,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27') AS lines,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_keys,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_ids,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27') AS loads
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period_label IN ('FY2026/27 P05') GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.quantity AS units
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.quantity_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.brand, cp.category, cp.subcategory,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales, SUM(n.units) AS net_units
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales, (s.store_id<>900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL) AS counted
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net, TRUE
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN counted THEN net_sales END),2) AS mine,
       ROUND(SUM(net_sales),2) AS mine_no_web_filter,
       (SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_sales),2) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27') AS control,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=999 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27') AS n999
FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27'

SELECT 'dup_name' AS chk, product_name AS a, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT sku) AS VARCHAR) AS b, CAST(MIN(sku) AS VARCHAR) AS c
FROM dim_product WHERE is_current GROUP BY product_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sku) > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'multi_current', CAST(sku AS VARCHAR), CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR), '' FROM dim_product WHERE is_current GROUP BY sku HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'top_versions', CAST(sku AS VARCHAR), product_name || ' ' || category || ' ' || CAST(valid_from AS VARCHAR) || ' ' || CAST(valid_to AS VARCHAR) || ' delist=' || COALESCE(CAST(delisted_on AS VARCHAR),'-'), CAST(standard_unit_cost AS VARCHAR)
FROM dim_product WHERE sku IN (100955,100927,103415,103434,102116,101398,103329,101411,101022,101375,101763)
ORDER BY 1,2
